d: Is James Fishback suggesting that America belongs to Christians alone? The Florida Republican has sparked outrage with remarks targeting Hindu, Muslim and Jewish Americans, arguing that the United States was built on Christian principles. A self-described Christian nationalist, Fishback has also drawn criticism for his inflammatory comments on race, religion and immigration. As Indian Americans and other minority communities navigate an increasingly polarised political climate, his rhetoric raises a larger question: who gets to define what it means to be American? Cary Johnston brings you…
